name: Nutshell
description: Nutshell is an AI-powered sales CRM and marketing automation platform for small businesses, combining pipeline management, built-in email marketing, and AI call transcription.
best_for: Small teams and individual entrepreneurs — Nutshell reports 5,000+ companies across 50 countries since 2009 — wanting a comprehensive CRM without complex setup.
features: Unlimited contact and company storage with custom fields
Two-way email and calendar sync with Gmail and Outlook
AI call and meeting transcription, summarization, and logging
Email marketing with templates, segmentation, and automation
Quote and contract creation and tracking within the CRM
Chatbot and forms for lead capture and meeting booking

tiers.name: Foundation
tiers.notes: $19/user/mo billed monthly or $13/user/mo billed annually. Includes 10 AI outcomes, unlimited contacts and storage, email and calendar sync, AI chatbot, form builder and landing pages, and the AI Agent Marketplace. No seat minimums or maximums; free live support on every plan.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: $32/user/mo billed monthly or $25/user/mo billed annually. Adds 20 AI outcomes, activity reports, sales quotas, lead assignment rules, custom stage goals, and hot leads.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: $49/user/mo billed monthly or $42/user/mo billed annually. Adds 40 AI outcomes, 5 custom pipelines, advanced reporting, sales automation, AI lead recaps and next steps, and a meeting scheduler.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: $67/user/mo billed monthly or $59/user/mo billed annually. Adds 100 AI outcomes, 10 custom pipelines, advanced meeting scheduler, audit log and changelog, email templates from Gmail and Outlook, and additional teams and territories.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: $89/user/mo billed monthly or $79/user/mo billed annually. Adds 150 AI outcomes, unlimited pipelines, unlimited custom fields, enterprise SSO, SQL data access, and phone support.

alternatives.name: Pipedrive
alternatives.description: A sales-focused CRM built around a visual, pipeline-first workflow.
alternatives.best_for: Sales teams wanting a simple, activity-based pipeline tool.

alternatives.name: Zoho CRM
alternatives.description: An AI-powered CRM with omnichannel engagement and deep workflow automation.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses of any size wanting an affordable, feature-rich CRM.

alternatives.name: Keap
alternatives.description: A small business CRM and marketing automation platform with invoicing built in.
alternatives.best_for: Small businesses automating follow-up, invoicing, and scheduling.
